name: dshui-for-vscode
description: The DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web UI embedded in VS Code, scoped to the workspace you have open. No workspace selection: the opened folder IS the dsh workspace, the sidebar lists only its sessions, and the input box always stays at the bottom.

dshui.autoOpen.description: Automatically open the dsh UI panel when a folder is opened.

dshui.server.port.description: Port for the embedded dsh web server. 0 lets the OS pick a free port (default). When set to a fixed number, the same port is reused for this workspace so browser-side state (localStorage) persists across sessions.

dshui.openFilesInVscode.description: Open files clicked in the dsh UI inside the current VS Code window (via the vscode://file scheme) instead of the OS default editor.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run copy:clients
